Implemented the `errorStack` options and processor registry on branch `error-stack-options`, committed as `0b88219`.

Verification: the TypeScript build and reproduction passed. The functional test run passed 81 tests, with the performance test excluded. In the full run, that test exceeded its 700 ms threshold while Node optimization was disabled; 81 other tests passed. The standard build initially segfaulted, so verification used Node’s `--jitless` flag.
